design.about: brand v1.2 (https://tbilisi.today/brand) as rules for a film an agent composes; Lane A's components keep them by construction
rules: One font family; hierarchy comes from size, weight and color only: no caps, no letter-spacing, no italics, no shadows, no outlines.
No category colors and no tints: grounds are the canvas and the panel, depth is a color step and a 1-2 px line.
Cards have radius 14; chips, badges, dots and buttons are fully round; distances are multiples of 4.
The mark is never framed, recolored or distorted.
Numbers are written in digits; quotes are in „…“ with the speaker's name; no long dashes.
The source and the time are always on screen.
